caption: The drawing features a single, centrally positioned object depicting a brown eagle with outstretched wings. The eagle's wings are fully extended to the sides, and the feathers are detailed, with the inner parts of the wings showing a lighter brown shade. The head is turned to the side, the beak is open, and the body and legs are rendered in solid brown tones. The talons are also apparent, pointing downward. The background is an off-white or beige color with occasional light marks or spots, and there are no other objects or decorative elements present. In the lower right part of the drawing, there is a signature that reads "Frank H. Gray."
title: Snow Breaker
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
